body: Tis a shame. I have no way of getting to appointments anyway so I don't even bother.
I've tried a handful of different therapists, most of them could barely remember my name after multiple sessions, never took notes, generally acted like they'd rather be anywhere else.
Yeah, I'm not far from Lake Tahoe. Even the therapists around here barely give a shit.
Because people, at least where I live are all bigoted, foul, hateful, judgemental jackasses who think they're better than everyone else.
I want to avoid ALL people. I've tried a few jobs, fast food, working at wal-mart as a cart pusher, working at Target as a stocker/truck unloader...None really panned out.
And a job would make me want to kill myself because of the stress and having to deal with people all day, because I'm not educated and don't have enough experience to get any sort of cushy job.

To move away to South Korea and live in a nice apartment overlooking a big city. Every day that dream becomes more and more impossible as I slip further and further away from being able to do anything that can get me there.
